_readme: The object that carries the quest. It says a line and sets has_gate_key, and both
happen because the map data says so - Interaction.decide owns 'a thing that opens
once', which is a verb every RPG wants and no game should have to write.

find.speaker: The hollow
find.text: Something under the roots, wrapped in cloth that has mostly stopped being cloth.

key.speaker: The hollow
key.text: A gate key. Heavy, cold, and unmistakably the right shape.
